results.detail: New Chrome tab loaded the task-local file: entry before dynamic matrix.
Default page labels the experience as synthetic; AI and network are explicitly disabled.
Empty capture remains rejected and does not show a record.
Non-sensitive text plus explicit confirmation displays only a current-page synthetic record.
A second identical confirmation reports an idempotent receipt without a new record.
Default-deny blocks restoration until explicit grant.
Explicit grant permits preview preparation but still requires exact CONFIRM.
Exact CONFIRM produces only the synthetic current-page recovery receipt; repeat is idempotent.
Revoke/deny clears preview and receipt and returns the UI to fail-closed.
Simulated failure removes partial display and states that nothing real was saved, authorized, or restored.
Navigation reaches no-reliable-suggestion page without fabricating a suggestion.
Restricted/offline page remains default-deny and says it reads, processes, and generates nothing.
Refresh after a confirmed capture clears both input and synthetic display.
Closing the task-local tab and opening the entry in a new tab starts with cleared state.
Tab reaches the skip link and Enter moves to main content; focus styles and 75% Chrome zoom are visible.
